stem: A packaging vendor claims nitrogen flushing preserves all cannabinoids and terpenes. What is the strongest response?
choices: Accept the claim because nitrogen is inert
Require condition-specific stability data because research shows packaging atmosphere can affect individual compounds without universally preserving total cannabinoids and aromatics
Assume package color is the only variable
rationale: A controlled cannabis study found modified atmosphere effects were compound-specific and did not universally preserve total high-value compounds.
